description: This file defines a 'Home' component for a furniture shopping web application, built with LightningJS. It manages layout, subscriptions to a centralized store, and displays product cards, header, and modal components.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component displaying a grid of product cards, header, and cart modal for the furniture shopping app.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the initial reactive state of the component, including layout dimensions, message texts, and UI flags.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Watches for changes in width and height to compute layout dimensions.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Sets up subscriptions to the AppStore to update the layout and messages based on product data and app state.

methods.name: async onInit
methods.description: Initializes component dimensions, loads product data if needed, and sets up initial layout.
